info.title: Dossier API
info.description: The Dossier sync + tracking contract. Implement this spec to build a Dossier-compatible backend the extension and web app can point at. Authenticate at POST /api/authenticate, then send the access token as a Bearer token on every protected request; refresh it at POST /api/refresh.

post.description: Exchange a valid refresh token for a fresh access token AND a fresh refresh token (rotation). The presented refresh token is revoked; reusing it later revokes the whole token family. Returns 401 if the token is missing, expired, tampered, already used, revoked, or is not a refresh token. Clients MUST store the returned refresh token.
